name: OpenAI API
description: Hosted GPT-family language, image, speech and embedding models behind a single REST API, with function calling and structured outputs.

name: Anthropic API
description: Access to the Claude model family over REST, with tool use, long context windows and prompt caching.

name: Google Gemini API
description: Google's multimodal Gemini models via API key, with a free tier for prototyping and support for large context inputs.

name: Groq
description: Very fast inference for open-weight models on custom hardware, exposed through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

name: OpenRouter
description: One API and one bill for hundreds of models from many providers, with routing and fallback between them.

name: Mistral AI
description: European lab offering open and commercial chat, code and embedding models through a hosted API.

name: Cohere
description: Enterprise-oriented language models with strong embedding and reranking endpoints for retrieval pipelines.

name: Together AI
description: Serverless and dedicated inference for open-source models, plus fine-tuning and image generation.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fast hosted inference for open models with function calling, JSON mode and fine-tuning support.

name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
description: Unified access to models from the Hugging Face Hub, served by several inference partners behind one token.

name: Perplexity Sonar API
description: Search-grounded answer models that return responses with citations, useful when an agent needs current facts.

name: DeepSeek API
description: Low-cost chat and reasoning models served through an OpenAI-compatible interface.

name: xAI API
description: Grok models for chat, reasoning and vision, available through an OpenAI-compatible API.

name: Replicate
description: Run community and official models, mostly image, video and audio, with a simple prediction API and per-second billing.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Run open models on Cloudflare's network from a Worker or REST call, with a daily free allowance.

name: Ollama
description: Run open-weight models locally and talk to them over a simple HTTP API on your own machine.

name: Brave Search API
description: Web, news, image and video search from an independent index, with a small free plan.

name: Tavily
description: Search and content extraction built for LLM agents, returning cleaned snippets rather than raw links.

name: Exa
description: Neural search engine that finds pages by meaning, with content retrieval and similar-page lookups.

name: SerpApi
description: Structured JSON results scraped from Google and other search engines, including maps and shopping.

name: Serper
description: Inexpensive Google search results as JSON, popular for quick agent lookups.

name: You.com API
description: Web search and research endpoints aimed at grounding AI applications with fresh sources.

name: Google Programmable Search
description: Google's site-search API for up to 50 domains. The Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers and ends on 1 January 2027, and whole-web search is no longer offered to new users.

name: SearXNG
description: Self-hostable metasearch engine that aggregates many engines and can return JSON for agents.

name: Linkup
description: Search API focused on premium and licensed sources, returning answers with source attributions.

name: Kagi API
description: Ad-free search plus summarizer and FastGPT endpoints for paying Kagi users.

name: Firecrawl
description: Turns websites into clean markdown or structured data, with crawl, scrape and map endpoints.

name: Browserbase
description: Managed headless browsers in the cloud for agents, with session recording and stealth features.

name: Playwright
description: Open-source browser automation library for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit in several languages.

name: Puppeteer
description: Node library that drives Chrome or Firefox through DevTools protocols for scraping and testing.

name: Jina Reader
description: Prefix a URL and get an LLM-friendly text version of the page back; a keyless tier exists with rate limits.

name: Apify
description: Platform with thousands of ready-made scrapers called Actors, plus infrastructure to run your own.

name: Crawl4AI
description: Open-source crawler that outputs markdown tuned for LLM pipelines, runnable locally or in Docker.

name: ScrapingBee
description: Scraping API that handles proxies, headless rendering and blocks behind a single request.

name: Bright Data
description: Large proxy network with web unlocker, scraper APIs and datasets for data collection at scale.

name: Cloudflare Browser Rendering
description: Run headless Chrome from a Worker or REST API to screenshot, scrape or automate pages.

name: Browser Use
description: Open-source library that lets an LLM control a real browser, with an optional hosted cloud.

name: Stagehand
description: Browser automation SDK that mixes plain-language actions with code, built on Playwright.

name: Scrapy
description: Mature Python framework for writing fast, scalable crawlers and extracting structured data.

name: Common Crawl
description: Free, open repository of petabytes of web crawl data, useful for research and training datasets.

name: Model Context Protocol
description: The open protocol that lets AI apps connect to tools and data through a standard client-server interface.

name: MCP Reference Servers
description: Official collection of example servers, including filesystem, fetch, git and memory, and a pointer to community ones.

name: GitHub MCP Server
description: GitHub's own server that lets agents read repos, manage issues and pull requests, and inspect workflow runs.

name: Playwright MCP
description: Gives agents browser control through accessibility snapshots rather than screenshots.

name: Context7
description: MCP server that pulls current library documentation into an agent's context to reduce outdated code.

name: Sentry MCP
description: Lets an agent look up errors, issues and traces in Sentry while debugging.

name: Cloudflare MCP Servers
description: Remote servers for managing Workers, docs, observability and other Cloudflare services from an agent.

name: Stripe MCP
description: Stripe's server exposing payment, customer and subscription operations plus knowledge search to agents.

name: Notion MCP
description: Hosted server for reading and writing Notion pages and databases from an AI client.

name: Linear MCP
description: Remote server for finding, creating and updating Linear issues and projects from an agent.

name: Supabase MCP
description: Connects agents to Supabase projects for schema design, SQL queries and configuration.

name: Official MCP Registry
description: The community-run catalog and API where MCP servers are published and discovered.

name: FastMCP
description: Pythonic framework for building MCP servers and clients with very little boilerplate.

name: Smithery
description: Marketplace and hosting for MCP servers, with a CLI to install them into clients.

name: LangGraph
description: Library for building stateful, multi-step agents as graphs, with persistence and human-in-the-loop controls.

name: LangChain
description: Widely used toolkit of components for LLM apps, covering models, tools, retrievers and chains.

name: CrewAI
description: Framework for orchestrating teams of role-playing agents that split up a task.

name: AutoGen
description: Microsoft's framework for multi-agent conversations and workflows, in Python and .NET.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
description: Lightweight SDK with agents, handoffs, guardrails and tracing as its core primitives.

name: LlamaIndex
description: Framework centred on connecting LLMs to your data, with ingestion, indexing and agent workflows.

name: Pydantic AI
description: Type-safe Python agent framework from the Pydantic team, with structured outputs and dependency injection.

name: Mastra
description: TypeScript framework for agents, workflows, memory and evals.

name: Vercel AI SDK
description: TypeScript toolkit for streaming text, tool calls and agents across many model providers.

name: Hugging Face smolagents
description: Minimal library where agents write and run Python code to complete tasks.

name: Semantic Kernel
description: Microsoft's SDK for adding models, plugins and agents to C#, Python and Java apps.

name: Google Agent Development Kit
description: Google's open-source toolkit for building, evaluating and deploying agents and multi-agent systems.

name: Cloudflare Agents SDK
description: Build stateful agents on Workers and Durable Objects with scheduling, websockets and MCP support.

name: DSPy
description: Programming framework that compiles prompts and weights from code and metrics rather than hand-written prompts.

name: n8n
description: Visual workflow automation with AI agent nodes; source-available and self-hostable.

name: Pinecone
description: Fully managed vector database with serverless indexes and integrated embedding and reranking.

name: Qdrant
description: Open-source vector search engine written in Rust, available self-hosted or as a managed cloud.

name: Chroma
description: Developer-friendly open-source embedding database that runs in-process or as a server.

name: Cloudflare Vectorize
description: Vector database built into Workers for storing and querying embeddings close to your code.

name: Weaviate
description: Open-source vector database with hybrid search and built-in vectorizer modules.

name: Milvus
description: Open-source, highly scalable vector database, also offered as the managed Zilliz Cloud.

name: pgvector
description: Postgres extension that adds vector columns and similarity search to an ordinary database.

name: LanceDB
description: Embedded, serverless vector database storing data in an open columnar format.

name: Mem0
description: Memory layer that lets agents remember user facts and preferences across sessions.

name: Zep
description: Long-term memory for agents built on a temporal knowledge graph of conversations and data.

name: Letta
description: Platform for stateful agents with self-managed memory, descended from the MemGPT research project.

name: Turbopuffer
description: Serverless search engine on object storage combining vector and full-text queries at low cost.

name: Redis Vector Search
description: Vector similarity and hybrid search inside Redis, handy when you already use it for caching.

name: Wikidata
description: Free collaborative knowledge base of structured facts, queryable by SPARQL and a REST API.

name: Wikipedia API
description: Read article text, summaries and search results from Wikipedia and sister projects without a key.

name: OpenStreetMap
description: Community-built world map data, downloadable or queryable through the Overpass API.

name: Data.gov
description: Catalog of US federal open datasets with a CKAN-based search API.

name: SEC EDGAR
description: US company filings and financial facts as JSON; requires a descriptive User-Agent header.

name: arXiv API
description: Search and fetch metadata for millions of open-access preprints in science and maths.

name: OpenAlex
description: Open index of scholarly works, authors and institutions, with a generous free API.

name: Open-Meteo
description: Keyless weather forecast and historical data API, free for non-commercial use.

name: World Bank Open Data
description: Development indicators for countries worldwide, available via a simple JSON API.

name: REST Countries
description: Simple API returning facts such as capitals, currencies and languages for every country.

name: NASA Open APIs
description: Free API key unlocks astronomy picture of the day, Mars rover photos, near-earth objects and more.

name: GDELT Project
description: Monitors global news in many languages and exposes searchable event and article data.

name: Hugging Face Datasets
description: Hub of community datasets with a viewer API for browsing and downloading them.

name: FRED Economic Data
description: Hundreds of thousands of economic time series from the St. Louis Fed, free with an API key.

name: Crossref API
description: Metadata and DOIs for scholarly publications, handy for citation lookups.

name: Resend
description: Developer-focused email sending API with a free tier and official SDKs.

name: Twilio
description: Programmable SMS, voice, WhatsApp and verification APIs used by many production systems.

name: Slack API
description: Build bots and apps that read and post in Slack workspaces using the Web API and events.

name: Telegram Bot API
description: Free HTTP interface for creating Telegram bots, with tokens issued by BotFather.

name: Discord Developer Platform
description: Bot and application APIs for building agents that live in Discord servers.

name: SendGrid
description: Twilio's transactional and marketing email service with a REST API.

name: Postmark
description: Transactional email with a reputation for fast, reliable delivery and clear logs.

name: Mailgun
description: Email API for sending, receiving and parsing messages programmatically.

name: AgentMail
description: Email inboxes created through an API specifically so agents can send and receive mail.

name: Vonage APIs
description: SMS, voice and messaging APIs from Vonage for global communications.

name: Microsoft Graph
description: One API for Outlook mail, Teams, calendar and files across Microsoft 365.

name: Gmail API
description: Read, send and label Gmail messages on a user's behalf through OAuth.

name: WhatsApp Business Platform
description: Meta's Cloud API for sending and receiving WhatsApp messages from businesses.

name: Cloudflare Email Routing
description: Free custom-domain addresses that forward to an inbox or run through an Email Worker.

name: GitHub REST API
description: Programmatic access to repos, issues, pull requests and Actions, with token or app authentication.

name: E2B
description: Secure cloud sandboxes where agents can run code and shell commands in isolation.

name: Cloudflare Workers
description: Run JavaScript and WebAssembly at the edge, with free daily requests and KV, D1 and R2 bindings.

name: Modal
description: Serverless Python compute with GPUs and sandboxes, defined entirely in code.

name: Daytona
description: Fast, secure infrastructure for running AI-generated code in disposable sandboxes.

name: Vercel
description: Platform for deploying frontends and serverless functions, with a REST API and sandbox product.

name: Docker
description: Container tooling that is the usual way to isolate and reproduce agent runtime environments.

name: Judge0
description: Open-source code execution service supporting dozens of languages through a simple API.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source Postgres backend with auth, storage and edge functions, handy for agent app state.

name: Neon
description: Serverless Postgres with instant branching, popular for giving agents disposable databases.

name: Fly.io
description: Run containers close to users on fast-booting microVMs, with an API for machines.

name: Langfuse
description: Open-source observability for LLM apps: traces, evals, prompt management and cost tracking.

name: LangSmith
description: Tracing, evaluation and monitoring platform for LLM applications and agents.

name: Stripe
description: Payments platform with APIs for one-off charges, subscriptions, invoicing and Payment Links.

name: Lemon Squeezy
description: Merchant-of-record platform for digital products that handles sales tax and VAT for you.

name: Shopify Admin API
description: GraphQL and REST interfaces for managing products, orders and customers in a Shopify store.

name: PayPal Developer
description: APIs for accepting PayPal and card payments, subscriptions and payouts.

name: Paddle
description: Merchant of record for software sales, handling billing, tax and compliance.

name: Square APIs
description: Payments, catalog, orders and inventory APIs for in-person and online sellers.

name: Polar
description: Merchant-of-record billing built for developers selling software, subscriptions and digital products.

name: Coinbase Developer Platform
description: APIs and wallets for onchain payments, including tooling for agents that transact in stablecoins.

name: x402
description: Open protocol that revives HTTP 402 so an API can charge small per-request payments from agents.

name: Adyen
description: Global payment platform for enterprises with unified online and in-store processing.

name: Wise Platform
description: APIs for international transfers and multi-currency accounts at transparent exchange rates.

name: WooCommerce REST API
description: REST endpoints for managing products and orders in WordPress-based WooCommerce stores.

name: Plaid
description: Connects apps to users' bank accounts for balances, transactions and identity data.

name: Gumroad
description: Simple storefront for selling digital goods, with a small API for sales and products.

name: DeepL API
description: Neural text and document translation API with glossaries and formality control. A free plan has a monthly character limit; paid plans are usage-based.

name: Google Cloud Translation
description: Google's text, document and batch translation service with basic and advanced editions and custom glossaries. Billed per character, with a monthly free allowance.

name: Azure AI Translator
description: Microsoft's REST translation service for text and documents with language detection and transliteration. Has a free tier with a monthly character limit, then pay as you go.

name: Amazon Translate
description: AWS neural machine translation for real-time and batch text and documents, with custom terminology. Billed per character, with a limited free tier for new accounts.

name: LibreTranslate
description: Open-source translation API built on Argos Translate that you can self-host for free. A hosted service with API keys is also offered for a fee.

name: Argos Translate
description: Open-source offline translation library for Python, with a command line tool and downloadable language packages. Runs locally with no API key.

name: Lingva Translate
description: Open-source, self-hostable alternative front end for Google Translate with a simple REST and GraphQL API. It depends on Google's service and public instances can be rate limited.

name: ModernMT
description: Adaptive neural machine translation API that learns from translation memories. Usage-based pricing.

name: Lara Translate
description: Translation API and SDKs from Translated that take context and translation memories into account. Has a free tier and paid plans.

name: Systran Translation API
description: Neural machine translation API from Systran with text, file and language detection endpoints. Plans are subscription or usage based.

name: Crowdin API
description: REST API for the Crowdin localization platform, covering projects, source files, translations and translation memories. Free for open-source projects; other plans are paid.

name: Lokalise API
description: REST API for the Lokalise localization platform, to manage projects, keys, translations and files. Paid plans, with a free trial.

name: Smartling API
description: APIs for the Smartling translation management platform, including file, job and machine translation endpoints. Paid, quote-based plans.

name: Weglot
description: Website translation service with a translation API and plugins for common site builders. Has a limited free plan; paid plans scale by word count.

name: NLLB-200 (Meta)
description: Meta's open No Language Left Behind models for translation between 200 languages. Weights are released under a non-commercial license and run locally or via Hugging Face.

name: Helsinki-NLP Opus-MT
description: Hundreds of small open translation models for specific language pairs, trained on OPUS data. Run locally with Transformers or through Hugging Face.

name: OpenAI Whisper
description: Open-source speech recognition model that can also translate speech from many languages into English. Run it locally for free, or use the paid hosted audio API.

name: Tatoeba
description: Community-built collection of example sentences with translations, available as free downloads under open licenses. Useful as parallel-text data for evaluation and training.

name: AI Manga Translator
description: AI manga and image translation with a web editor and a credit-based API. Free guest trial with watermark.

name: Apertium
description: Open-source, rule-based machine translation platform, strongest for closely related and under-resourced languages. Runs locally, or as a web service through the apertium-apy server.

name: Bergamot Translator
description: Open-source client-side neural translation engine that powers Firefox Translations. Compiles to WebAssembly or a native library and runs small models fully offline.

name: Mozilla Translations Training Pipeline
description: Mozilla's open pipeline for training the compact translation models used by Firefox Translations, from data cleaning to quantized release models.

name: CTranslate2
description: Fast inference engine for Transformer translation models, with CPU and GPU support and quantization. Converts models such as Opus-MT, NLLB, M2M100 and MADLAD-400.

name: OpenNMT
description: Open-source toolkit for training and running neural machine translation and other sequence models, with PyTorch and TensorFlow implementations.

name: Marian NMT
description: Efficient open-source neural machine translation framework written in C++, used to train the Opus-MT models. Includes a server mode.

name: M2M100 (Meta)
description: Meta's multilingual model that translates directly between 100 languages without pivoting through English. Open weights on Hugging Face, run locally with Transformers.

name: MADLAD-400 (Google)
description: Open multilingual translation models from Google trained on the MADLAD-400 dataset, covering more than 400 languages. Several sizes are published on Hugging Face.

name: SeamlessM4T (Meta)
description: Meta's multimodal model for speech-to-speech, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and text translation across about 100 languages. Weights have a non-commercial license.

name: mBART-50 (Meta)
description: Open many-to-many translation model fine-tuned from mBART for 50 languages. Run locally with Transformers.

name: Tower (Unbabel)
description: Open multilingual language models from Unbabel and partners, tuned for translation-related tasks such as post-editing and named-entity handling. Check each model card for its license.

name: Aya 101 (Cohere Labs)
description: Open instruction-following model covering 101 languages that can be prompted for translation. Run locally or through Hugging Face.

name: TranslateGemma (Google)
description: Open translation models built on Gemma 3 in 4B, 12B and 27B sizes, evaluated on 55 languages. They can also translate text found in images. Released under the Gemma terms.

name: Hunyuan-MT (Tencent)
description: Open translation-focused models from Tencent's Hunyuan team. Weights are on Hugging Face; check the model card for languages and license.

name: IndicTrans2
description: Open translation models from AI4Bharat for all 22 scheduled Indian languages and English, with evaluation benchmarks. Run locally or via Hugging Face.

name: Sarvam Translate API
description: REST translation API for English and Indian languages. Mayura covers 11 languages with formal and colloquial modes; Sarvam-Translate covers the 22 scheduled languages. Usage-based pricing.

name: Lesan AI
description: Machine translation API for Ethiopian languages, with English, Amharic and Tigrinya in the documented API. Published price is per character, with speech recognition also offered.

name: Masakhane
description: Grassroots research community building open datasets and models for machine translation of African languages. Resources are published on GitHub and Hugging Face.

name: Tilde Machine Translation
description: Machine translation from a Latvian language-technology company, with custom engines for European and smaller languages. Commercial, quote-based plans.

name: Yandex Cloud Translate
description: Yandex Cloud's neural translation API for text, with language detection and glossaries. Billed per character.

name: Naver Papago Translation
description: Papago neural machine translation offered through NAVER Cloud Platform, strong for Korean, Japanese and Chinese. Billed per character.

name: Baidu Translate API
description: Baidu's text translation API with many language pairs, documented mainly in Chinese. Requires an account with app ID and key; standard use has a free monthly quota.

name: Youdao Translation API
description: NetEase Youdao's text, document and image translation services, documented mainly in Chinese. Requires a registered application.

name: Tencent Cloud Machine Translation
description: Tencent Cloud's text, image and speech translation services, accessed with Tencent Cloud API credentials. Billed by usage.

name: Alibaba Cloud Qwen-MT
description: Translation-tuned Qwen models in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, called through an OpenAI-compatible API with term and domain controls. Billed per token.

name: ElevenLabs Dubbing API
description: API that translates and dubs audio or video into other languages while keeping the original speakers' voices. Consumes plan credits.

name: HeyGen Video Translation API
description: API that translates a video into other languages with dubbed audio and lip-sync, returning captions as SRT and VTT. Consumes API credits.

name: Rask AI API
description: Video and audio dubbing, translation and transcription API with glossaries and optional lip-sync. Uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials.

name: Soniox
description: Speech platform with real-time speech-to-text that can also return live translation, one-way or two-way, across 60+ languages. Usage-based pricing.

name: Speechmatics
description: Speech recognition API with translation of transcripts into other languages, for batch and real-time audio. Has a free tier, then usage-based pricing.

name: DeepL Voice API
description: DeepL's real-time speech translation API for live captions and interpretation. Available on selected DeepL API plans.

name: Doctranslate
description: Document, image, audio and video translation that keeps the original layout, with an API for integrations. Has a free tier; paid plans add volume.

name: Gengo
description: Human translation marketplace with a REST API for ordering, tracking and fetching translations. Priced per word.

name: Unbabel
description: Machine translation with automated quality estimation and optional human post-editing, available by API. Quote-based plans.

name: Phrase API
description: APIs for the Phrase localization suite, covering string management, translation memory, jobs and machine translation. Paid plans.

name: Transifex API
description: REST API for the Transifex localization platform to manage projects, resources, translations and glossaries. Paid plans.

name: POEditor API
description: REST API for the POEditor localization platform, to manage terms, translations and exports. Has a free plan with limits; larger projects are paid.

name: Tolgee
description: Open-source localization platform with in-context editing, machine translation and a REST API. Self-host for free or use the hosted cloud service.

name: Lingo.dev
description: Open-source CLI and compiler that use LLMs to translate app strings and i18n files, with a hosted engine and API. Has a free tier.

name: Weblate
description: Open-source web-based continuous localization platform with a REST API and machine translation integrations. Self-host free, or use paid hosting.

name: Localazy
description: Localization platform with a REST API and CLI, and a free plan for small and open-source projects. Paid plans scale by usage.

name: Intento
description: API layer that routes translation requests to many machine translation engines and recommends the best one per language pair and domain. Commercial plans.

name: Lingvanex
description: Machine translation API and self-hosted on-premise option covering over 100 languages. Commercial plans.

name: RWS Language Weaver
description: Enterprise machine translation from RWS with adaptable engines and a cloud API. Quote-based pricing.

name: OPUS
description: Large open collection of parallel texts in many languages, with a public API for searching and downloading corpora. Widely used to train translation models.

name: MyMemory
description: Free translation memory and API from Translated, returning matches contributed by humans and machine translation. Anonymous use has a daily limit.

name: deep-translator
description: Python library with one interface to many translation services, including some unofficial free endpoints. Paid providers need their own keys.

name: DeepL MCP Server
description: DeepL's official MCP server exposing text and document translation, rephrasing and glossary lookups. Needs a DeepL API key.

name: Lara MCP Server
description: Official MCP server for Lara Translate, hosted with OAuth or self-hosted with access keys. Supports context, translation memories and glossaries.

name: Co-op Translator
description: Microsoft open-source tool that translates Markdown, notebooks and images in repositories, with a CLI, Python API and MCP server. Needs an Azure OpenAI or OpenAI key.
